Baker Boyer National Bank decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 36.92% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Baker Boyer National Bank sold 11,664 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 19,927 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.34 million, down from 31,591 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Baker Boyer National Bank who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $912.69B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.62% or $3.05 during the last trading session, reaching $185.69. About 29.26 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
